title: Active workout state and persistence regressions
original_report: Пользователь сообщил, что после добавления подхода нажатие чекбокса затрагивает предыдущие подходы, а добавленный подход пропадает после выхода и нажатия «Продолжить». Дополнительно запрошен аудит связанных с тренировкой дефектов.
discovery_scope: Active workout screen and Approach component state transitions
Local DataProvider result actions and remote snapshot mapping
Authenticated workout-results API and replacement persistence semantics
Exercise note and set deletion persistence

candidates.candidate: Overlapping set saves can change an earlier set
candidates.contract: A checkbox action targets one set ID and must not change another set.
candidates.trigger: A newer set update reaches the server before a stale full-snapshot save for another set.

candidates.candidate: Added or unlogged sets disappear on resume
candidates.contract: Visible planned and added sets must remain present after returning through Continue.
candidates.trigger: Two planned sets plus a saved third set, with no result for planned set #2.

candidates.candidate: Dashboard marks an exercise complete before all planned sets are complete
candidates.contract: An exercise is complete only when all of its required sets are complete.
candidates.trigger: One completed result exists for an exercise with three planned sets.

candidates.candidate: Deleted set results return after remote reload
candidates.contract: Deleting a set must persist across reload and synchronization.
candidates.trigger: Call results.remove in authenticated remote mode, then reload remote results.

candidates.candidate: Saved exercise notes are not persisted
candidates.contract: The Save action must preserve the note after leaving and reopening the session.
candidates.trigger: Save a changed note and reopen the active workout.

expected: Each set action changes only its target; all visible sets, correct progress, deletions, and saved notes survive navigation and remote synchronization.
actual: Stale snapshots overwrite other set state, missing-result gaps disappear, progress is overstated, deleted results return, and saved notes revert.
environment: macOS, Node.js 22.22.2, Vitest 4.1.9, authenticated remote DataProvider path
reproduction: Focused fixtures execute the current production mapping, dashboard calculation, DataProvider remove method, note callback, and real in-memory server API. Each assertion isolates one reported or adjacent workflow invariant.
failure_signal: All five cases failed on their intended behavioral assertions with exit code 1; no setup, import, syntax, timeout, or dependency failure occurred.
root_cause: Per-set changes are serialized as replace-all result snapshots without revision ordering; remote mapping reconstructs rows only from existing results and ignores gaps implied by plannedSets; dashboard completion checks only persisted results; result removal has no remote mutation; note saving updates only component state.
fix_summary: Serialized remote writes per session; rebuilt remote workouts from the complete planned/result set range; persisted blank added sets, planned set counts, deletions, reindexing, and notes; and based dashboard completion on every required set.
why_causal: The same five production-path reproducers that failed before the changes now pass, while the broader project suites remain green. Each fix removes the exact state-loss or stale-snapshot condition isolated by its reproducer.

limitations: The audit covers the active authenticated workout lifecycle, not every planning, history, or administrative screen.
The overlapping-save timing is deterministic in the API harness; a manual real-device pass was not performed in this turn.
residual_risks: The per-session queue intentionally adds network latency when many edits are made rapidly.
Server-side revision control would provide additional protection for writes originating from multiple devices.
